Editorial Policy

The Global Desk is committed to the highest standards of journalistic integrity. Our editorial policy outlines how we gather, verify, and publish news.

1. Accuracy and Fact-Checking

Every piece of news published on The Global Desk goes through a verification process. We rely on primary sources, official statements, and trusted news agencies (like Reuters, AP). Unverified rumors are never published as facts.

2. Independence

We are an independent platform. We do not accept funding from political parties or governments. Our analysis is unbiased and reflects a global perspective.

3. Corrections

If we make a factual error, we will correct it promptly and transparently. We do not delete past articles; instead, we update them with a visible correction note.

4. AI Usage

We may use AI tools for drafting and translation, but all final content is reviewed and approved by human editors before publication.
